qualification: Emulator control-state evidence; physical reboot/audio remain unverified under explicit owner exception
ownerStatement: Approve release and closure with hardware reboot/audio unverified
rootCause: Packed settings in unused NEIGHBOR source slots can have their high bit set (default SPAN 12 gives 0xC0). Stock Part validation clamps these as negative parameters and returns a repair count that rejects the complete saved bank at boot.
implementation: For valid S2/1 or S2/2 Flex/Static instances, save and clear exactly twelve reserved bytes, run the real stock validator, restore those bytes and return the stock result unchanged. All ordinary machine parameters and unrelated tracks remain checked.

regression.oldResult: All eight machine kinds reset to STATIC; PLAY running=1, all steps remain zero
regression.isolatedControl: Changing only packed SPAN 12 to SPAN 4 in private battery RAM prevents reset; removing the markers also prevents reset
regression.newResult: Same failing saved battery state preserves both instances and all eight Flex assignments; PLAY advances steps 3, 6, 9

environment.model: MKI boot/transport and MKII menu mapping
environment.bootProcedure: Restore only 1 MiB battery RAM before boot and retain card; no mount/load commands. Compare separately with explicit fresh saved-card project load.

limitations: No physical instrument was flashed or rebooted; no working audio, audio continuity, maximum mixed-module load or hardware stack canaries were observed.
Part save/reload used native handlers; project SAVE/RELOAD used actual MKII panel menu keys and card contents were checked. MKI menu navigation was not qualified.
Two distinct TYPE/SEED settings were exercised. Sample selector state was compared and preserved; distinct sample/engine audio, instance reset and replacement were not tested.
Original and new battery-only restarts were tested both with VECTOR alone and with the reported five-module composition.
Old S2 formats are retained; projects already reset cannot be recovered by this fix. Restore a known-good backup.
Firmware, stock disassembly, cards, raw LCD/RAM dumps and compiled images stay private.
